concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-marketplaces-payment-methods-manage-payment-methods-api]] — 2026-09-15 Marketplace merchant-level Management API guide to list/read/update configured payment-method settings, with support/availability constraints and 90-day disabled-method deletion.
warnings: Disabled payment methods are automatically deleted after 90 days (raw line 363).
An empty countries/currencies array expands only to those supported by that payment method; appearance within a day is typical, not guaranteed (raw lines 34–35, 359–360).
